*Hartford gate kiosk incident – summary for Mateo Quiroga's procurement team*
• *First report:* 10:42 AM. Both inbound lanes at Vantorre's Hartford plant showed a white screen after badge scan. The guard logged trailers by hand in the meantime.
• *Kiosk 1 back:* 11:03 AM. Mateo confirmed the guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch could see it.
• *Both lanes confirmed working:* 11:07 AM.
• *Scope:* this was gate check-in only. Scheduling from the dispatch office kept working. Carrowmere Cloud was checking the Hartford gateway route.
• *Still open:* the separate status-page access issue for Mateo's login, tracked in INC-4821.
